blinding: NONE; candidate geometric proposal labels visible
required_views: Two opposite depth-correct whole-object views highlighting C, plus two C-only views. If unclear, keep UNCERTAIN or inspect an additional view; do not guess semantic identity from the proposal label.
scope: Each base candidate in the frozen 72-parent manifest; same original TRAIN/DEV split. No generated outputs are used to select data.

row_schema.actual_part: SEAT_SURFACE / LEG_SUPPORT / BACK_SURFACE / SEAT_SUPPORT / SEAT_BACK / PART_ASSEMBLY / OTHER / UNKNOWN
row_schema.extent_description: Concrete visible scope, e.g. complete selected seat top, one leg side surface, U-shaped end frame, back slat; do not claim full solid part unless visible evidence supports it
row_schema.notes: Specific visible support for identity and any ambiguity or defect; topology comes from separate quality check

acceptance: A clearly interpretable coherent real source part/part surface with plausible user-input geometry; no minimum condition face fraction beyond K>=2. Each region can be a surface of a part, but must be named accurately. Geometric quality PASS is a separate additional requirement for ACTIVE.
non_acceptance: An underside is not silently called a seat top; a side/arm panel is not silently called a back. A visibly coherent seat-plus-support candidate can be accepted under SEAT_SUPPORT, but never counted as a pure leg. Isolated splinters or ambiguous source mixtures stay out of the primary pool. Lack of a back on a backless object is NA, not a failure to fill a quota.
combinations: Only union accepted same-parent component face IDs, then run geometry quality and actual composition-image review. Multiple components are permitted if their visible relation is coherent and explicitly disclosed; no invisible welding or added faces.
